instruction: Gere um prompt para seedream para criar uma imagem de envelope
prompt:
Ultra-detailed, cinematic fantasy composition featuring a luxurious decorative envelope as the main subject, positioned in the foreground with a strong central presence. The envelope is handcrafted and premium, made from textured watercolor paper in soft shades of ocean blue, icy white, pale aqua and subtle silver accents. Its surface features delicate hand-painted watercolor washes inspired by underwater light, with elegant folds, precise geometry and realistic paper fibers. The closure is adorned with a refined pearl-like wax seal shaped as a seashell, complemented by a translucent white ribbon with subtle blue reflections and tiny aquatic ornamental details.

The envelope is placed within a rich underwater environment, not a flat backdrop. Surrounding elements include gently swaying seaweed, delicate white coral, translucent shells, soft bubbles, flowing ribbons of aquatic plants, tiny glowing particles and subtle rays of sunlight filtering through the ocean surface. The background forms a dreamy underwater scene with layered blue gradients, distant coral formations and softly blurred marine textures, remaining visually recognizable while keeping the envelope as the clear hero. The composition feels serene, elegant, magical and refined, inspired by a soft watercolor illustration with premium editorial styling.

Lighting is ethereal and cinematic, with a soft diffused key light illuminating the envelope, delicate cool rim light outlining its edges and volumetric beams descending from above as if sunlight were passing through clear seawater. Subtle underwater haze, floating bubbles and luminous particles catch the light. Shadows remain soft, realistic and fluid. Use a harmonious palette of powder blue, ocean blue, pale aqua, white, pearl and very subtle silver, with smooth watercolor gradients, gentle pigment blooms, translucent washes and controlled contrast.

Composition: foreground-focused, envelope sharply in focus, background softly defocused, strong sense of depth and perspective. Camera: macro lens look, shallow depth of field, crisp focus on the watercolor paper texture, seashell seal, ribbon and ornamental details, cinematic bokeh created by distant underwater particles. Style: hyper-realistic premium watercolor aesthetic, delicate hand-painted textures, cinematic underwater fantasy realism, elegant, soft, magical and sophisticated. Technical details: 8K ultra-high resolution, realistic paper materials, refined watercolor pigments, global illumination, volumetric underwater lighting, high dynamic range, editorial-grade finish. Aspect ratio: 9:16. Avoid text, logos, harsh neon colors, flat backgrounds and overly saturated tones.
folhaInstruction: Gere um prompt para seedream para criar uma imagem de de uma folha em branco com adornos em torno, sendo essa folha o objeto central e principal da imagem, ocupando quase a tela toda, mas ainda deixando espaço para visualizar o chão, o fundo e os elementos laterais
folhaPrompt: Ultra-detailed, hyper-realistic cinematic composition featuring a pristine blank white sheet of paper as the main subject, positioned vertically in the foreground and occupying almost the entire frame while preserving visible space around it to reveal the ocean floor, underwater background and lateral decorative elements. The sheet has a premium handcrafted texture, subtly fibrous matte paper, clean edges, realistic thickness and gentle natural curvature, remaining completely empty with no text, symbols, logos or writing. It is elegantly framed by underwater ornaments: delicate blue corals, seashells, pearl-like bubbles, sea grass, translucent jellyfish, small tropical fish, starfish and floating aquatic particles arranged organically around the sides and corners without covering the writable central area. Theme: enchanted Fundo do Mar, with a rich narrative underwater environment rather than a flat backdrop. The ocean floor is visible beneath the sheet, covered with fine pale sand, scattered shells and soft blue shadows; the background contains recognizable coral formations, distant rocks and flowing sea plants, softly blurred but visually contextual. Cinematic underwater lighting with luminous rays filtering from the surface above, soft caustic reflections projected across the paper and seabed, subtle volumetric blue haze, floating bubbles and suspended particles catching the light. The sheet remains the clear hero, sharply focused and brightly illuminated, with delicate rim lighting outlining its edges and realistic soft directional shadows grounding it naturally on the ocean floor. Intentional color palette dominated by elegant ocean blues, cyan, turquoise and pure white, with controlled contrast, luminous highlights and harmonious gradients. Composition: foreground-focused, central blank sheet nearly filling the 9:16 frame, enough negative space to reveal the floor, background and lateral decorations, balanced symmetry, strong depth and perspective. Camera: frontal slightly elevated macro lens look, shallow depth of field, crisp focus on paper texture and edges, cinematic underwater bokeh in the background. Style: photorealistic, hyper-detailed, cinematic fantasy realism, elegant, magical, premium stationery aesthetic, inspired by Disney’s The Little Mermaid, Pixar’s Luca and Aquaman, while avoiding recognizable copyrighted characters, logos or exact franchise-specific designs. Technical details: 8K ultra-high resolution, realistic paper and underwater materials, global illumination, underwater caustics, volumetric lighting, high dynamic range, editorial-grade rendering, aspect ratio 9:16, no text, no watermark.
aberturaInstruction: Crie um prompt de geração de vídeo para essa imagem com a abertura do envelope e um brilho saindo de dentro, no final o brilho vai fazer a tela ficar toda em branco sólido ao aumentar o brilho.
aberturaPrompt:
A animação começa focando em um envelope fechado com um único selo de cera. Assim que o selo de cera se desprende fisicamente e cai no chão, ele não é substituído, duplicado nem regenerado em momento algum. O envelope permanece permanentemente aberto após esse instante, sem que surja qualquer outro selo.
Uma vez removido o selo, a aba do envelope se levanta lentamente. De seu interior, emergem brilhos cintilantes, poeira brilhante e rastros de luz radiante, espalhando-se pelo ambiente em um espetáculo hipnotizante, com feixes mágicos de partículas luminosas que se curvam em torno do envelope, passando à sua frente e por trás em um movimento contínuo. Essas partículas originam-se apenas de dentro do envelope, aumentando em densidade e luminosidade à medida que se deslocam.
A luz radiante se intensifica e se expande para fora, preenchendo gradualmente toda a cena. Nenhum novo objeto físico é introduzido durante essa transição. O brilho intenso dos feixes e das partículas transforma-se em uma tela branca sólida e deslumbrante no quadro final. A câmera aplica um zoom sutil e lento.
aberturaSlide2Prompt: Remove the envelope from the image completely, revealing only the beautiful background scene, keeping all other elements intact. The result should look natural without any envelope.
